intent: Implement CorrelationWebFilter exactly as tabled. Single correlation middleware. Adopts the inbound X-Request-Id header or generates a UUID, echoes it in the X-Request-Id response header, and installs correlation by contextWrite of key requestId into the Reactor Context of the downstream chain (public constants CONTEXT_KEY="requestId", HEADER="X-Request-Id"). Correlation lives in the Reactor Context and as an explicit field of every audit record; no other propagation mechanism is installed.
